heading: Lead Role Or Position
content:
Currently, I play the role of a Module Lead in my team.

One of my responsibilities is preparing the shift roster. Since we
provide 24/7 production support and have three shifts, I coordinate with
my team every week and prepare the shift roster accordingly. I'm also
available for on-call support whenever required.

Apart from that, I train the newly joined team members. I handhold them
throughout the Knowledge Transition (KT) process until they are
confident enough to work independently.

Even after the KT is completed, I'm always available to support and
guide them whenever they need any help.

I strongly believe in teamwork. Especially in a production support role,
teamwork is very important because we need to coordinate with our own
team as well as different IT teams to resolve issues within the SLA. I
believe that teamwork always leads to better results.

heading: How Will You Handle the Angry Customers
content:
Well, the first thing in handling an angry customer is that I try to
understand the issue from his perspective. I put myself in his shoes.

I empathize and acknowledge the customer, and I make sure he knows that
I'll support him. I take ownership of the issue and give him a solution,
along with an ETA for when it will be resolved.

I also assure him that I'll follow up, and I'll be the driving key in
resolving the issue until closure.

If my shift is over, I make it a point to mention in the handover mail
or catch‑up call to the next executive that this particular customer is
irate and has this particular issue, so continuity is maintained.

Once the issue is resolved, I call the customer and inform him that the
issue has been fixed. I explain the RCA from our side and give him
assurance that this issue won't happen again.

And finally, I let him know that he can call whenever he wants regarding
any issues he faces.

heading: How Will You Handle The Customer
content:
The first thing in handling a customer is that I always greet them
politely.

Then I listen carefully to their issue without interrupting, because
it's important to understand the problem from their perspective and put
myself in their shoes.

I empathize and acknowledge the customer, and I make sure to assure them
that I'll support them. I take ownership of the issue and provide a
solution, along with an ETA for when it will be resolved.

At the same time, I use my technical skills to diagnose and fix the
issue, or escalate it to the right team if needed.

I keep the customer informed about the progress so they don't feel left
out.

heading: Tell me about any of our achievements
content:
When I was working with MI Infotech, Our company gave me the employee of
the month award

I was luckily awarded the employee of the month for two times in a row.

In sept, October 2024, i was awarded employee of the Month.

I was awarded this because i had handled around 180 Tickets that Month
and also i did

few automations and resolved some space issues which were troubling us
for a long time.

In our company every month they will send out an internal mail and
notify who has been awarded the employee of the month, It was good to
see my name on that email for consecutive month months, It was
motivating and helped me to pushed myself more and perform better at
work.

heading: Pressure situation at work
content:
As you know i work for 24/7 support, we don't get leave on Saturdays
and Sundays.

Even on festival days, we have to support.

It was during this jan 15 2024, It was Pongal and most of my team were
on off.

I was doing a double shift and covering for my team.

During that day we had two p1 issues at the same time, I got little
panicked

because i need to coordinate and close both of them within the SLA.

This was the critical application, the customer escalated this issue and
was angry.

I somehow multitasked and handled both the issues and resolved them

within the SLA and gave an update to all the stakeholders.

I felt happy and satisfied because i single handedly

coordinated both the issues at the same time and closed the issue.

I was alone in my entire floor that at night :)

I was little scared if i will able able to fix but i successfully
handled,

later the team my manager and management sent me a thank you note for
supporting.

I felt good that my efforts were appreciated.
